title.purpose: The ledger title in the page header.

headline.purpose: Section and panel heads, the HOME header; uppercase, tracked.

item.purpose: Phase and task titles, stat values, HOME ledger titles.

label.purpose: Column heads, meta lines, action links, states; uppercase, tracked.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Colour, background and opacity changes on hover and focus (transition .15s).

motion.name: flash
motion.purpose: One-time hover-lift flash on an item reached from a link.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default action in the swarm panel and toolbars: bare uppercase label, the hover lift appears behind it.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; color: var(--accent); font: 700 11px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Stop, close ledger, delete: the ghost button in the destructive red.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; color: var(--destructive); font: 700 11px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--destructive); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Link
components.description: Small inline action (reply, edit, show all comments): muted at rest, accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font: 11px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; transition: color .15s; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--accent); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Inset Input
components.description: Comment and answer boxes: a surface-2 well; focus draws an accent underline.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 280px; min-height: 64px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); font: 13px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 transparent; transition: box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--dim); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--accent); }

components.name: State Label
components.description: Bare uppercase state word with a leading status dot; no capsule, no glow.
components.css: .ds-state { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 11px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--positive); } .ds-state::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: A folding section on surface-1 with an uppercase head ruled in signal red when open.
components.html:
OPEN QUESTIONS

Approve or reject proposal one.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 16px 18px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-1); } .ds-panel-head { margin: 0 0 12px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--signal-soft); font: 700 12px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .16em; color: var(--text); } .ds-panel-body { margin: 0; color: var(--text-2); font: 13px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }

components.name: Outline Navigation
components.description: Fixed left list of section links; red bullet for open items, accent when current.
components.html: Claude and Codex messagingSeats and continuity
components.css: .ds-outline { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 248px; font: 13px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-outline a { position: relative; display: block; padding: 3px 10px 3px 24px; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-outline a::before { content: '•'; position: absolute; left: 11px; color: var(--signal); } .ds-outline a:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--text); } .ds-outline a.on { color: var(--accent); } .ds-outline a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -1px; }

narrative.overview:
A dark, dense control surface for one operator watching many agents. The page is a record first: hairline-divided rows of monospaced text on a near-black canvas, with colour reserved for state. Structure follows the operator's design system 2026-001: bare labels instead of chips, frameless controls that show a surface only on hover, depth from two translucent lifts over a single canvas, and every colour in one palette file.

Two operator decisions override 2026-001 here. First, no glow: no text-shadow, drop-shadow or halo box-shadow on text, icons or controls. Role colour, weight and size carry emphasis. Second, the canvas is near black (#010104) with no blue radial wash behind it.

Density is high and calm. A ledger page holds dozens of panels and hundreds of rows and must stay readable after hours open.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace everywhere, five sizes (22 / 14 / 13 / 12 / 11 px), uppercase tracked labels for section and column heads.
Near-black canvas, two white lifts (4.5% and 6%) for panels and wells, hairlines (6%) between rows.
Colour is state: blue for action and links, green done or running, yellow paused or warning, red signal, destructive and open items.
Frameless controls; the hover lift is the only frame.
Flat: no shadows and no glow.

rules.name: The One File Rule
rules.body: A colour value appears only in palette.css. Changing a hue is one edit there; a change that needs a component file opened means the palette layer is broken.

rules.name: The State Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue means state. A colour used for decoration takes that meaning away from the state it stands for.

rules.name: The Flat Type Rule
rules.body: Text never glows. Emphasis comes from weight, size, case and role colour.

rules.name: The Two Lifts Rule
rules.body: Every panel samples to one of two surface values. A third value is a component painting its own surface.

dos: Do take every colour from a role token in palette.css.
Do carry status with role colour and an optional status dot.
Do keep controls frameless at rest and show the hover lift on hover and focus.
Do keep every section foldable, remembering its state per viewer.
Do keep a visible focus-visible ring on every control.
donts: Don't use text-shadow, drop-shadow or halo box-shadow on anything.
Don't paint a blue or other tinted wash behind the canvas.
Don't wrap labels in chips, badges or pills.
Don't add a third surface level; reach for a hairline instead.
Don't write a colour literal outside palette.css.
